profile.headline: Software Developer @ D.E. Shaw & Co.
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software Developer @ D.E. Shaw

B.S. in Computer Science and Technology

4x Internships as a Software Engineer at Meta (Facebook)
ML intern at Scoville

Two-time winner of the ICPC Mexican Regional (2018 and 2020), and World Finalist representing Tecnológico de Monterrey in Porto and Dhaka.

Bronze medalist in the IOI 2018, silver medalist in the CIIC 2018 and gold medalist in the OMI.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software Developer on the Investment Management team
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Jupyter · Data Analysis · Finance

positions.title: AI Engineer
positions.description: Worked on an AI project, developing an internal tool for text anonymization. The tool was developed using relevant AI tools like LLMs, Generators and Neural Networks

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked on Instagram Entity Quality Platform, developing an algorithm to find images and videos incorrectly labeled as malignant on the platform, achieving an accuracy of 62% and remediating around 300 thousand cases. Also developed an algorithm to improve percentage of non recommendable media reviewed all across Instagram, improving the metrics from 50% coverage to 80% coverage.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: Worked on the Well Being Teen Safety Team. Worked on a project to develop an internal tool to improve efficiency and effectivity of team planning and projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Worked on the Video Infrastructure Fabric Team and developed a project to mux and demux mp4 progressive videos all over the platform.
Developed code that impacts over 1 billion video requests daily

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Worked on the Marketplace Integrity Team and developed a project to improve support and commerce care.
Decreased review tools loading time by 50-60%.

honors.title: ICPC 2022 World Finalist
honors.description:
- Participated with a new team in the ICPC 2020 regionals (held in 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic).
- Ended up in 1st place among all Mexico teams, and 2nd place among all Latin America teams (including South America).
- With our remarkable performance, we earned a place in the Dhaka, Bangladesh ICPC World Finals, which was held in November, 2022.

honors.title: ICPC World Finalist 2019
honors.description:
- More than 16,000 teams from over 110 countries annually participate in ICPC. Roughly over 100 of them make it to the
Finals. My team (me and two colleagues) were one of those finalists.
- University & Regional Champion: To classify to the finals, our team went through two elimination rounds:
- Local Stage: I competed against teams in my university (Tecnologico de Monterrey).
- Regional Stage: I competed against teams in my continental region (Mexico and Central America).
My team scored 1st place in both the Local and Regional round.
